mentions.name: slk
mentions.description: A fast, keyboard-driven Slack client with a terminal user interface (TUI), designed as a daily-driver alternative to the desktop app.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on slk (https://github.com/gammons/slk) which is a TUI Slack client that runs in a terminal. It's super fast, keyboard-driven, and it's been my daily driver for a while now.
